text: When a task title starts with ESB- it is a Jira ticket in the ECOM epic. Many of my tasks have no ticket at all — a bare title is normal, not missing information.
The SDS epic is the design system: its shared components, its LWC component library, and its releases.
LIT-LWC tasks are my Lightning Web Components learning work, not client delivery.
'Check Prod:' tasks are post-deploy verification. They are quick, usually a 1 or a 2.
A 13 is one or two days of work. Anything bigger should be split rather than estimated.
Each epic is a silo with its own stakeholder, so they are never mixed together in a report.
